bun — Bun Compatibility Facade

Zig 0.17This plugin is built with Zig 0.17: the 0.17 branch builds successfully with Zig 0.17 and passes the Zig unit tests; the old 0.14.1 branch is left untouched.

sa_plugin_bun rewrites the synchronous subset of the Bun namespace as a native SA C-ABI surface: in the words of its API_COVERAGE.md, it is "a native SA replacement surface for the synchronous subset of the Bun namespace. It does not call the bun executable and does not embed the Bun runtime" — it does not invoke the bun executable and does not embed the Bun runtime. This page explains its upstream basis, the composition of its 60 externs, the verification chain for its bit-exact hashes, and what is explicitly out of scope.

NoteThe authoritative sources, in order, are sap.json (capability sections and permissions), bun.sai/bun.sal (ABI contract and macro facade), API_COVERAGE.md (coverage ledger), and tests/bun_smoke.zig (41 smoke tests). The upstream basis is a shallow clone (--depth 1) of oven-sh/bun (HEAD 9f70da07, v1.4.2); the type contract is defined by packages/bun-types/bun.d.ts and its {serve,sqlite,s3,sql,redis,ffi,shell,test}.d.ts files.

1. Positioning and Scale: The Composition of the 60 Externs

MetricValueBasis
bun.sai externs60Measured with grep -c '@extern'; the return type is uniformly u32 (0 ok / 1 not-found / 2 error / 3 unsupported-stub, consistent with the main node/deno surfaces)
Macro facade94 [MACRO] entries in bun.sal60 direct calls + an alias layer (BUN_FILE/WRITE/SLEEP/GZIP/…) + 22 serve/websocket delegations
Zig sourcesrc/bun_saasm_api.zig + src/bun_hash.zigThe former holds the native implementation of each domain; the latter is a bit-exact port of the hash algorithms
SA-side smoke tests41 items in tests/bun_smoke.zigZig host tests linked directly against libbun.so, not .sa tests
Artifactzig-out/lib/libbun.soartifacts in sap.json

2. The Five Skills and the Host Permission Boundary

sap.json declares five capability sections: bun.sys, bun.env, bun.fs, bun.hash, and bun.process. The permission ledger (enforced by the host):

DimensionDeclared contentImpact
fsread/write/create/delete on $PROJECT/** and /tmp/** BUN_FILE_READ_TEXT / BUN_WRITE and similar can only reach these two roots
netAll methods on https://* + http://localhost / http://127.0.0.1 BUN_SERVE_* listens on localhost; outbound traffic goes through http-client
envHOME, PATH, TMPDIR, SA_* The Bun.env trio is constrained by the allowlist
process"spawn": true, with an exec allowlist of only /usr/bin/env BUN_SPAWN_SYNC uses the native Child.run; BUN_SHELL_EXEC uses /bin/sh -c, subject to what the host actually allows

3. Three-Layer Call Architecture

The same three-layer structure as deno (the header of bun.sal has @import "bun.sai" + "sa_http_client.sai" + "sa_http_server.sai"):

LayerSymbols reachedMacro families
① The plugin's own C-ABIsa_bun_plugin_* (exported by libbun.so) version family, env, files, hashing, encoding/decoding, compression, processes, semver, shell, stdio, capability snapshots
② Reused sibling pluginssa_http_server_* (including websocket_upgrade/read/write/free) 18 BUN_SERVE_* + 4 BUN_SERVE_WS_*; outbound fetch stays in http-client (it is a Web global, not a Bun.* namespace API)
③ Reused SA standard libraryAs needed in futureThe current .sal does not directly reference sa_std macros; frame-level serve operations can be extended via NET_WS_* in the same way as on the deno page

Macro family (count)MembersRepresentative parameter order

Hashing and randomness (10 + 2 aliases) BUN_HASH_U64 / HASH_CRC32 / HASH_WYHASH64 / HASH_XXHASH64 / HASH_XXHASH32 / HASH_ADLER32 (+ BUN_HASH / BUN_HASH_XXHASH), BUN_SHA256_HEX / SHA512_HEX / RANDOM_BYTES / RANDOM_UUID_V7 (+ BUN_RANDOM_UUID) BUN_HASH_WYHASH64 %out_hash, %out_status, %data, %data_len, %seed; constants BUN_HASH_FNV1A64=0 / CRC32=1 / WYHASH64=2 / XXHASH64=3

5. The Bit-Exact Hash Verification Chain

The JS binding for Bun.hash lives in src/runtime/api/HashObject.rs: the default is wyhash (seed 0), and every algorithm function has the uniform form hash(seed, input) -> Output; string inputs are always hashed as UTF-8 bytes — consistent with the byte semantics on the SA side, so no transcoding layer is needed. This plugin ports them bit by bit in src/bun_hash.zig:

  • wyhash final4 (Wyhash::hash in src/wyhash/lib.rs, a 48-byte round + 4 secrets; note that this is not the same algorithm as the legacy Wyhash11): Bun.hash("hello world") = 0x668d5e431c3b2573, plus coverage of the 240-byte cross-round path and seed=42, all matching the live bun@1.4.2.
  • XXH64/XXH32 (via src/highway, "bit-identical to the xxHash reference"): including the [240,0] = 0xb1d89115ab8aa560 vector and the empty string with a large seed (16269921104521594740 → 3224619365169652240).
  • HMAC-SHA256: RFC 4231 TC1 confirmed against both the CPython hmac and OpenSSL oracles; SigV4 confirmed via the CPython chain.
NoteThe seed semantics follow upstream exactly: at the binding layer, xxHash3 truncates the seed to u32 before widening it again (seed as u32 as u64); a port of this algorithm must preserve that truncation, or the output drifts. cityHash32 has no seeded variant (a seed passed from JS is ignored).

6. Explicit List of Unimplemented / Out-of-Scope Items

planned_native (standard algorithms awaiting porting; the vectors are all ready in test/js/bun/util/hash.test.js): cityHash32/64, murmur32v3/v2, murmur64v2, rapidhash, xxHash3, and seeded crc32 (currently only seed 0 is exposed, i.e. the standard zlib value).

stub_unsupported (status 3 + snapshot JSON): bun:sqlite (use sa_plugin_db), Bun.S3 object transfer (only the signing part is native), Bun.RedisClient (an asynchronous RESP3 client), bun:ffi (the dlopen bridge; see FFI vs bc2sa: Two Paths for Bringing in External Code), Bun.build/Transpiler/plugin (the bundling subsystem; see vite), and bun:test (use the native sa test).

Structural limitations: the same as deno/node — file reads and writes are limited to $PROJECT/** and /tmp/**; the asynchronous lifecycle of Bun.spawn (exit subscriptions, kill signal groups) is out of scope, only the spawnSync subset is covered; resolveSync for bare specifiers (such as lodash) returns 1, because a full node_modules/Bun resolver implementation is required.

Warning wyhash has two incompatible variants (Wyhash11 with a 32-byte round / 5 primes vs the current final4 with a 48-byte round / 4 secrets). An upstream comment states explicitly: "THESE ARE DIFFERENT ALGORITHMS". Bun.hash() uses final4; if you write a hash by hand on the SA side, be sure to use BUN_HASH_WYHASH64 (final4) and not the legacy variant by mistake.
